title: Phase 2b - Pre-2025 event_day_only Characterization + Dev Sample Verification
summary: T1: spine guard 20,951 pass; cohort reconciliation 287 (trades)/386 (quotes) both pass and fully reconcile against coverage_class.parquet. T2: dev sample v2 membership check ESCALATED - 15/50 events (14 file2/2025 + PLBY_2021-02-16 file1) are event_day_only, not full_window - hard stop per the phase's own escalation table. Amendment 1 authorized and executed: A1-T1 prior-use safety scan clean (0 true hits across 7 candidates); A1-T2 v2 builder located unambiguously (research/phase_1b/build_dev_sample_v2.py); A1-T3 built dev sample v3 (eligibility = v2's rule + coverage_class='full_window' AND quotes_full_window=TRUE; 50/50 events pass, 0 mismatches) with 0/50 overlap vs v2 (descriptive, not a bug - explained in decisions_log); A1-T4 added weak_listing_signature to T3's classification; A1-T5 repointed CLAUDE.md's dev sample to v3, v2 retained as historical. T3 (resumed, refined): classified all 287 cohort events, 0% unclassified. T4: 3 charts.

decisions_log.reason: rng.choice(pool.index,...) draws against each run's own filtered-population DataFrame indices; changing the eligibility filter changes row composition/order even though the pool only shrank ~18%, so index alignment across runs was never guaranteed - faithfully inherited from build_dev_sample_v2.py per the amendment's explicit instruction not to reinvent the stratification

decisions_log.decision: T3's bitmap_by_label groupby-apply bug fixed (tuple dict keys from pandas' auto-flattening) before commit
decisions_log.reason: json.dump cannot serialize tuple keys; replaced with an explicit loop over groupby groups, re-ran the full script for a consistent script+artifact pair

surprises: T2's escalation itself: 1 of the 15 dev sample events failing full_window was pre-2025 (PLBY_2021-02-16), not just the expected 14 2025 events - v2's eligibility rule had a real pre-2025 gap, not just a 2025-shaped one.
0/50 overlap between dev sample v2 and v3 - a completely disjoint re-draw, not a subset/superset relationship, despite the eligible pool only shrinking ~18%.

PLBY_2021-02-16's weak_listing_signature independently reproduces a known real-world fact (SPAC merger consummation date) purely from within-archive data, with no external lookup performed on the cohort.

215/287 (74.9%) of the cohort is backward_missing (pre-event flank absent) vs. only 26 (9.1%) forward_missing (post-event flank absent) - a strong asymmetry in which side of the event window goes missing.
